docs: Clean-room reading bar. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. When the browser supports scroll-driven animations, a vertical bar with no custom offset scales on the X axis with animation-timeline scroll(root), or scroll(nearest) inside a container. use-scroll-progress is the fallback and the source of aria-valuenow. The scale follows scroll and does not tween on its own, so reduced motion does not freeze it. A scroller with no overflow reports 0. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite use-scroll-progress or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
